verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents programmatic access across its main surfaces: Python/TypeScript SDKs for evaluations, prompt sync, and span querying, plus a remote MCP endpoint that can search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations. No evidence claims full API–UI parity, and some workflows are described as UI-first (human annotations attached in the UI, evaluators configured in the UI). missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, a published REST/OpenAPI reference (the OpenAPI probe found nothing), programmatic equivalents for UI-only flows like annotation and evaluator configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
